result: A normalized nonnegative extra relation of weight16 must involve at least two outside root mate pairs.
meaning_of_one_pair: The support lies among the ten labels on letters0,1,2,3,a,a', where(a,a') is one of the five outside mate pairs. The tail is nonconstant and the usual star-minimal normalization is imposed.

new_exclusions.42: Exact Farkas contradiction0<=-2 using kernel equations, root caps, common-neighbour inequalities and edge bounds.
new_exclusions.44: Exact Farkas contradiction0<=-1 using the same ingredients.
new_exclusions.45: Exact Farkas contradiction0<=-2 in the shared-cut scan, or0<=-1 in the earlier individual scan; no PSD cut is used by either certificate.
new_exclusions.31: Binary CP-SAT infeasible at presolve,0 branches; repeated as a stronger problem with ALL orientation PSD cuts removed and no spectral checks, still infeasible in0.122 solver seconds.
new_exclusions.46: Binary CP-SAT infeasible at presolve,0 branches; with ALL orientation PSD cuts removed and no spectral checks, still infeasible in0.174 solver seconds.

proof_status: The coefficient coverage is direct finite enumeration. Three new exclusions have portable exact integer linear-combination certificates. The two others are completed finite integer-solver UNSAT results; no standalone SAT proof trace is claimed.

fractional_relaxation_example.interpretation: The star equations, root-letter caps, Q connectivity cuts and both PSD conditions alone admit a fractional rank30 point. This is not a graph and it violates C2, so it does not refute(A).

open: Weight16 remains possible on two or more outside mate pairs. Assertion(A) and C1 remain open; no asymmetric SRG is constructed. All local pilot runs have ended.
